en.name: Pius II
en.summary: A celebrated humanist writer and diplomat before his election, who spent his papacy vainly trying to rally a fractured Europe for a new crusade.
en.body: Pius II, born Enea Silvio Piccolomini, had been a renowned humanist poet, diplomat, and author, including of a notably frank autobiography, before entering the priesthood and rising to the papacy. His reign was dominated by tireless but largely unsuccessful efforts to organize a unified European crusade against continued Ottoman advances following the fall of Constantinople; he died at Ancona while personally awaiting the departure of a crusading fleet that key allies had failed to fully support.
